goal: Keep the Immune-Brain Footer empty in both runtime behavior and active documentation while presenting session-owned Enrollment preflight progress through one bounded aboveEditor Widget whose timer, cancellation, commit, and shutdown lifecycle cannot alter Kernel authority or the existing Host-native Assurance surfaces.

acceptance.assertion: Enrollment and Assurance publish no defined-value ctx.ui.setStatus content at any lifecycle stage; both Enrollment commands remain non-blocking and share one bounded aboveEditor Widget that shows task, stage, elapsed time, and only the currently valid cancellation action, while cleanup-only setStatus(key, undefined) remains permitted solely for stale older-version UI.

Normal completion, preflight failure, user cancellation, confirmation rejection, commit success or failure, UI exceptions, and session shutdown stop every refresh timer and clear only the owning Widget; repeated or concurrent shutdown is idempotent, stale callbacks cannot affect a later job, cross-command single-flight remains deterministic, and no presentation signal settles or changes enrollment authority.

Deterministic Assurance QA continues using bounded deduplicated notify updates without a custom Footer or Widget, Review remains visible through the standard Agent surface, cleanup-only stale UI removal remains best-effort, and Enrollment progress does not append Pi session entries, inject Chat messages, trigger model turns, or scan Session directories.

Active README guidance contains no Footer-based Immune-Brain progress claim and satisfies the current Bun plus TypeScript, v4 runtime, Pi-only host, and Pi package installation documentation contracts.
The Pi extension remains type-correct after the coordinator, timer, Widget, and shared shutdown ownership changes.

The complete repository regression passes with no change to descriptor execution, Kernel reducers, TaskIntent or TaskRecord schemas, capability binding, enrollment receipts, QA progress semantics, Review dispatch, or authorization flow.
